records.claim_text: The holiday-pay guidance makes working-arrangement classification depend on the specific contractual pattern, and distinguishes the applicability of named methods by worker type and leave year. A sector or headcount label does not supply those facts.
records.locator: Introduction; sections1–2 and3.1; method application, not rate calculation
records.limitations: No individual worker classification, employment-law conclusion, calculation or inference that a whole sector uses one method. The guidance itself is not definitive advice for each case.
